observation.command:
cd /workspace/biletado && sed -i 's|dockerfile: Dockerfile|dockerfile: Dockerfile.lean|' docker-compose.yml && grep -n dockerfile docker-compose.yml
# Start the build in background
nohup docker build -f /workspace/smart-city-booking-backend/Dockerfile.lean -t smart-city-booking-backend:local /workspace/smart-city-booking-backend > /workspace/biletado/build.log 2>&1 &
echo "build started pid $!"
